name: MortgageCompletionPaymentConfirmed
trigger: CHAPSPaymentSettled (EVT-111) is published and CHAPSPaymentExecution.is_mortgage_completion_payment = true. SVC-009 publishes MortgageCompletionPaymentConfirmed to notify SVC-002 (Mortgage Service) that the property purchase completion payment has settled. Enables SVC-002 to close the mortgage completion lifecycle (JRN-006).
capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-009); consumed by CAP-001/SVC-002 (Mortgage Service). Crosses CAP-003 → CAP-001 boundary. Connects JRN-028 (CHAPS payment) back to JRN-006 (mortgage completion).

payload_schema.completion_date: string (YYYY-MM-DD) — extracted from settled_at for mortgage record

field_mappings.note: Date portion of settled_at — YYYY-MM-DD extracted

consumers.action: Transitions MortgageAccount (ENT-016) status to 'completed'. Sets completion_date. Triggers completion documentation pack dispatch. Completes JRN-006 mortgage lifecycle. Idempotent on mortgage_account_id + chaps_execution_id.
Audit trail linking mortgage completion to CHAPS settlement event

ordering_guarantees: Per-mortgage ordering via mortgage_account_id. Published after EVT-111 for the same execution. SVC-002 consumer must be idempotent — duplicate publication must not result in double completion.
worm_rationale: Mortgage completion is a regulated financial event. Links CHAPS settlement (payment audit) to mortgage lifecycle (MCOB audit). Required for regulatory evidence trail. 7-year retention.
cross_journey_note: This event is the bridge between JRN-028 (CHAPS payment) and JRN-006 (mortgage completion). It must be consumed by SVC-002 to close the JRN-006 lifecycle. Any change to this event schema requires review against JRN-006 artefacts.
